limits: One repeat only; routing and arrival timing vary. These are replica GPU reservations on a fixed8-H100 node, not measured billing savings.
Original16-session linear-interpolated ramp and hold unchanged; no session down-ramp was configured.
No during-load producer removal should be claimed unless an actual during-load downscale appears. After-load removal alone does not prove a later request reused that producer cache.
Twelve observed ClientPayloadError streams coincide with proxy reload+120s clusters; retained old proxy stderr confirms forced connection closure. Per-socket tracing was not collected.
Two cancelled credits have no profile records; observed success/latency statistics exclude them.
Optional AIPerf GPU telemetry manager dropped after missed heartbeats; GPU-utilization export may be incomplete. Replica reservation telemetry remains available.
Mooncake operation histogram sums are approximate: Ray maps >4s observations to8s. Direct vLLM interval logs show longer successful average transfers.
Session graph rows are observed request spans. Last observed request end does not establish natural session completion or exact recycled lane ownership.
Recompute-on-load-failure policy is configured, but zero observed GET failures does not exercise that fallback.
